title: Fun evening and we made great food!
text: We had a fun time becoming chefs at this evening cooking class! We made sangria, a cold tomato soup, chicken paella, and a Catalan Cream. This fun to learn how to make these dishes and of course great to eat the end product! We highly recommend spending a couple hours with Tommy cooking!
author: Gail_W

title: Best cooking class
text: Tomas was friendly and encouraging in teaching us how to cook. It was a great location and facilities. Also we got the recipes to try to recreate the meal at home. This is a must do if you are in Granada.
author: Jeannie_A

title: Fun night for everyone!
text: This class did not disappoint!! We learned how to make several Spain classics including sangria, paella, Spanish omelet (potato). Chef (“Tommy” 😊) was informative and fun. Highly recommend.
author: Timothy_M

title: Great activity for guests
text: This was our third time with Guillermo.  All have been a bit different but all great.  It the perfect thing to do with guests in town.  You get a really authentic meal and have fun making it.
author: nancykaymar

title: Amazing Experience in Granada!!
text: Amazing experience. I loved how we made several dishes. Our instructor was great. Loved how we were able to cut up vegetables.
author: Megan_C

title: Great experience and excellent host.
text: Great experience cooking 4 Spanish meal courses and sangria. Everyone was given different dishes which all came together at the end for a wonderful meal. Jose was very enthusiastic and welcoming and did everything he could to make the experience memorable. Would highly recommend.
author: Shane_I

title: World class cooking class!
text: I signed my mom and teenage son up for this class and three months later they are still talking about it. The chef was personable and shared about his career path. My family actually made the meal instead of having it all prepped for them. Bonus- it was delicious. Next time I’m taking the class myself!
author: Britney_J

title: Fantastic experience with Guillermo!!
text:
Guillermo was incredibly professional and made the entire experience fun, insightful, and most importantly delicious.

From the moment we arrived to the final bite of a truly satisfying meal, everything flowed at a perfect pace. Guillermo created a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere, blending great energy with engaging interaction throughout.

The food was outstanding, and what truly stood out was the passion and expertise shared in such an enjoyable and approachable way.

I would highly recommend this experience—thank you, Guillermo, for an unforgettable time!
author: Elaine_M

title: The real deal
text: Definitely go hungry and pace yourself.  It is a lot of food but it is all fantastic and you cook it.  Great instruction and a fun time.  We had a senior and a teen in the group and it was still a blast.  We live in Granada.  This is the real deal.  I almost hate to post this for fear I won’t be able to get friends in when they come to town.  It really is fantastic.
author: nancykaymar

title: Paella Class
text: Chef William was entertaining and extremely knowledgeable about the dishes he made. Everything was delicious. We got so many tips and are all motivated to try this at home.
author: Mary_Z
